nodes.assumption: the builder can implement Cairn proof files (with one tooth per falsifier clause, using the hypothesize-section instruments), probe files (verifying feedback round-trip via bus posts), and instance charters (inheriting or specializing the tool class charter structure)
nodes.would_settle: Provide implementation patterns or worked examples showing how to write a Cairn proof file (tooth structure, testing framework usage), a Cairn probe file (what gets verified each beat, how to signal findings), and what an instance charter contains (reference to tool class, instance-specific overrides, or both).

nodes.would_settle: Specify the exact CLI command or method signature for each workflow operation: emitting a crossing, running a hollow seal, writing a verdict artifact, depositing to learning, and pushing to both repos; clarify what 'hollow seal' means (proof structure verified, not run) vs. live seal.

nodes.would_settle: Provide example implementations or point to a similar tool instance placement (e.g., the existing data_recorder placement under codemother) that demonstrates the expected proof, probe, intention file, verb handler, and backpack patterns.
